articles.title: GST collections stay on track, rise 15% in July
articles.description: India's July GST collections surpassed ₹2.11 lakh crore, showing a 15.4% year-on-year increase. Import GST surged significantly, contributing to the overall robust revenue growth. Domestic consumption also showed resilience, reflecting steady household spending and industrial activity. Manufacturing states reported increased GST collections, despite higher refund payouts. Experts noted the import-driven growth warrants further examination of its underlying causes.

The facility encourages overseas fund mobilization and boosts foreign exchange reserves. This scheme remains available until late 2026 for various deposit types.

articles.title: July GST collections up 15.4% to Rs 2.1 L cr on higher imports
articles.description: Goods and Services Tax collections rose 15.4 percent to Rs 2,11,205 crore in July. This increase was largely due to a 29 percent jump in integrated GST on imports. Strong economic activity and higher commodity prices also contributed to the robust tax collections. Central GST mop-up increased 12.3 percent while state GST grew 8.7 percent. Net collections after refunds went up 15.8 percent, reflecting continued economic resilience.
